title: アカデミックライティング(再履修クラス)
subtitle: Academic Writing
keywords: How to write a report 2.How to reference literature 3.Gathering information
educationalGoal: Develop reporting skills in major fields. In the process of finding and solving problems, you must summarize your ideas to convey the information. You will learn how to write a report on topics in specialized fields, which will introduce you to new subjects and provide skills that will aid in the preparation of a thesis.
advice: To develop a foundation in skills such as identifying problems, gathering and analyzing information, solving problems, reporting information, and distinguishing between plagiarism and appropriate referencing. Through these skills, you will learn how to write a report on topics in a specialized field based on the information gathered. 1. Understand the technology trends in the field of applied chemistry. 2. Identify problems in the field of applied chemistry, gather information, and analyze the information gathered. 3. Learn the language of applied chemistry, and how to format and complete a report. At each stage of report preparation, report ideas and drafts are evaluated together and advice, suggestions, and corrections are discussed with others.
books: Textbooks: Unspecified Reference books: Unspecified Reserved books: Unspecified
requiredKnowledge: The knowledge needed to use the LC for information gathering and familiarity with research on the internet. Be comfortable with group discussions to facilitate the exchange of advice during the report writing process.

activityGoals.body: Be able to identify problems in applied chemistry and choose a theme for the report.
Be able to gather and analyze information in the field of applied chemistry.
Be able to prepare a report that conforms to standards in the field of applied chemistry.

achievementLevels.ideal: Learn foundational skills such as identifying problems, gathering and analyzing information, problem solving, reporting, and referencing literature without plagiarizing. Prepare compelling reports with references based on the information gathered.
achievementLevels.standard: Learn foundational skills such as identifying problems, gathering and analyzing information, problem solving, reporting, and referencing literature without plagiarizing. Prepare reports with references based on the information gathered.

lessons.content: Understand the structure of a report. Learn how to write a report.
lessons.assignments: Understand the content of the lecture.

lessons.content: Understand the current issues in applied chemistry. - Read references - Gather information - Choose report theme
lessons.assignments: Read textbooks, notes, and reference books on applied chemistry. Investigate available themes and select one.

lessons.content: Prepare a report according to the theme selected. - Finalize report theme - Prepare the report outline - Gather information from electronic journals using the Internet
lessons.assignments: Read textbooks, notes, and reference books related your theme. Prepare the report outline.

lessons.content: Prepare a report according to the theme selected. - Prepare a draft - Research literature related to the theme - Gather information from electronic journals using the Internet
lessons.assignments: Bring textbooks, notes, and reference books related to the theme to prepare a draft. Prepare the draft, which will be submitted next class

lessons.content: Prepare a report based on the theme selected. - Submit and revise the draft
lessons.assignments: Bring the necessary materials for revising the draft. Revise the submitted draft.

lessons.content: Prepare a report according to the theme selected. - Return the draft, and review
lessons.assignments: Revise the submitted draft. Revise the returned draft and prepare a report after considering the suggestions of others.

lessons.content: Prepare a report according to the theme selected. - Submit the report
lessons.assignments: Prepare to submit the report within the allotted time.
Identify your mistakes and review your weaknesses.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
 ※学習課題の時間欄には、指定された学習課題に要する標準的な時間を記載してあります。日々の自学自習時間全体としては、各授業に応じた時間(例えば2単位科目の場合、予習2時間・復習2時間/週)を取るよう努めてください。詳しくは教員の指導に従って下さい
